seat_direction: *** THE ONE SECTION IN THIS BATCH WITH PER-SECTION EVIDENCE THAT ACTUALLY BEARS ON THE SEAT-1 SIDE, AND IT POINTS THE OPPOSITE WAY FROM THE BOILERPLATE. *** BOILERPLATE (park-wide, identical on every Fenway section page): "When looking towards the field/field/stage, lower number seats are on the left". PER-SECTION FAN REVIEWS, quoted verbatim with their attribution lines: (1) titled "Don't have to worry about the beams in Row 1" (GS18 / Row 1 / Baseball): "There is a support beam which sits just 4 seats in from the right aisle and directly in the line for Row 1. There are no seats in Row 1 which will have an obstructed view, but be cautious if sitting any higher (Rows 2 and up)". (2) titled "Convenient and shaded, but crapshoot view" (GS18 / Row 14 / Baseball): "Last row in the section, but there's nothing really nearby to walk to. You're taking a gamble sitting here. Seats 1-4 seem to be safe but anything to the left will deal with the pole. And all seats will deal with the overhang. Small tvs are pretty much worthless." (3) titled "The charm of Fenway Park is not so charming" (GS18 / Row 2 / Baseball): "...View of home plate and infield is outstanding. View of the outfield is a green support beam. Other seats in this row are better. But seats 3-8 are terrible. Nice shade here though." (4) titled "Stay within 6 seats of the left aisle" (GS18 / Row 2-16 / Baseball): "Seats closer to the right side of Grandstand 18 will have to contend with the support beam for a view of the batters box and pitchers mound. But if you can stay no more than 6 seats in from the left aisle, you'll be left with tremendous views of the infield." READ TOGETHER, (1)+(2)+(3) locate the beam 4 seats in from the RIGHT aisle AND locate the affected seats at numbers 3-8 with "seats 1-4 ... safe but anything to the left will deal with the pole" - i.e. seat 1 sits at the RIGHT aisle and numbering runs right-to-left. That is the opposite of the boilerplate.
notes: *** DIRECT CONTRADICTION, RECORDED NOT RECONCILED. *** The park-wide boilerplate on this very page says "lower number seats are on the left". The per-section fan reviews on the same page put the beam "just 4 seats in from the right aisle" and simultaneously say "Seats 1-4 seem to be safe but anything to the left will deal with the pole" and "seats 3-8 are terrible" - which only coheres if seat 1 is at the RIGHT aisle. That agrees with the venue seating-chart page (https://www.rateyourseats.com/fenway-park/seating/seating-chart : "Seat Numbers at Fenway Park go from right-to-left") and disagrees with the boilerplate. This is the first per-section evidence found at Fenway that bears on the question discovery.json flagged as unresolved; it is one section's fan-supplied text and is offered as evidence, not as a resolution. CAVEAT: review (4) advises staying "no more than 6 seats in from the left aisle", so reviews (2) and (4) recommend opposite aisles; they are consistent only if the section is wide enough that seats 1-4 (right aisle) and the leftmost 6 seats are both clear of a beam that sits 4 seats in from the right - review (3)'s "seats 3-8 are terrible" sits awkwardly with review (2)'s "Seats 1-4 seem to be safe".
